description: Names as first-class entities beside persons. A name is what was written on a ballot; a person is who stood. Many-to-many.

policy.punctuationVariants: Distinct names, same person. "Sean T O'Kelly" and "Sean T. O'Kelly" are two name ids.
policy.tokens: Associative only. "Ian" links to Ian Paisley and hundreds of others; it does not identify him. identifying is always false.
policy.nullPerson: A candidacy may carry a confident nameId with a null personId. That is the honest state, not a gap.
